suicide_risk_safe_t.rationale: Excellent SAFE-T framework application in PSY-SUICIDE-MHA MCQs. Specific plan, access to means, feelings (hopelessness), earlier attempts, and threat assessed. High-risk correctly identified (plan + means + intent + refuses help → involuntary admission). Minor: Could strengthen protective factors assessment in some scenarios.

mental_health_act.rationale: Mental Health Act criteria well-applied: mentally ill, risk to self/others, refuses treatment, no less restrictive alternative. PSY-SUICIDE-MHA-20260125-2012/2020/2028/2036/2044/2052/2060 correctly identify involuntary admission criteria. Minor: Could specify NSW/VIC/QLD state differences more explicitly (e.g., Section 27 NSW vs Assessment Order VIC).

medication_safety.rationale: Good medication safety: Australian names (sertraline, quetiapine, olanzapine), clozapine monitoring correct (weekly FBC 18wk → fortnightly → monthly), lithium levels mentioned, metabolic risk stratification accurate (aripiprazole < risperidone < quetiapine < olanzapine/clozapine). Minor: Could add more QTc monitoring details for antipsychotics, thyroid/renal monitoring frequency for lithium.

cultural_safety.rationale: Cultural safety NOT addressed: No Aboriginal/TSI scenarios, no SEWB framework, no intergenerational trauma, no Aboriginal liaison mentions. MCQs are clinically sound but lack cultural diversity required for Australian AMC Clinical Exam. Recommendation: Add at least 2-3 Aboriginal/TSI mental health scenarios per 100 MCQs.

clinical_accuracy.comments: Clinically accurate content aligned with RANZCP guidelines, Australian eTG Psychiatry, and Mental Health Act (NSW/VIC/QLD). Two minor issues: (1) Cultural safety not addressed, (2) Generic key_points in auto-generated MCQs (PSY-ANX-BIP-20260125-2000 onwards) instead of scenario-specific learning points.

educational_value.comments: High educational value: Evidence-based treatments (SSRI + CBT), appropriate risk stratification, comprehensive side effect coverage. Explanations are clear and align with AMC Clinical Exam standards. Could improve by adding more clinical reasoning steps and Australian-specific guidelines citations (e.g., RANZCP CPG for Mood Disorders).

australian_context.comments: Australian context present: Medication names (sertraline, not Zoloft), Mental Health Act NSW/VIC/QLD, crisis contacts (Lifeline 13 11 14, Beyond Blue 1300 224 636). Missing: Aboriginal/TSI cultural considerations, SEWB framework, state-specific Mental Health Act nuances (e.g., Section 27 vs Section 33 NSW).

agent_evaluations.recommendation: APPROVE with minor revisions: Add Aboriginal/TSI mental health scenarios (10% of MCQs), customize key_points for auto-generated MCQs, specify Mental Health Act state differences (NSW Section 27 vs VIC Assessment Order). Overall, clinically sound psychiatry MCQs suitable for AMC Clinical Exam preparation.
